              issuer later signs every user out.

Tenant settings                                               ⚠ affects all apps
  ~ CIMD support                off → on
  ~ iss in sign-in redirects    off → on                  every app's redirects
  ~ resource parameter profile  audience → compatibility
  + company domain              https://shop.example

API https://api.shop.example
  + scope poppy:browser-sign-in  "Use the website signed in, with the other
                                 access you approve"
  ~ offline access               off → on
  ~ agent subject claims         off → auth0-v1
  ~ Poppy API                    off → on
  ~ guest policy                 none → require_client_grant

API https://pay.shop.example
  + scope poppy:browser-sign-in  "Use the website signed in, with the other
                                 access you approve"
  ~ offline access               off → on
  ~ agent subject claims         off → auth0-v1
  ~ Poppy API                    off → on
  ~ guest policy                 none → require_client_grant

App Shop Web
  ~ browser join  off → on

Guest grant
  + https://api.shop.example  scopes: orders:read, checkout,
                              poppy:browser-sign-in
  + https://pay.shop.example  scopes: pay, poppy:browser-sign-in

File
  + auth0-poppy.json  new

To apply:  auth0 poppy setup --company-domain shop.example \
             --api https://api.shop.example --api https://pay.shop.example \
             --api-url https://api.shop.example=https://api.shop.example/openapi.json \
             --api-url https://pay.shop.example=https://pay.shop.example/openapi.json \
             --app "Shop Web" --guest-api-access --guest-all-scopes
